column2: [intro]
I don’t like things when they're perfectly done,
Visible seams make me shiver, not fun.
Handcrafted’s my creed, my true devotion,
DIY till the end, that's my notion.
We tinker, we assemble, we create with pride,
In our creations, our hearts reside.
The little flaws, that’s what makes them shine,
It’s what sets us apart, our unique sign.
No need to be perfect to be adored,
In our imperfections, true love is stored.
We can tinker and tweak, doing what we can,
But always aiming to be the best we can.
We tinker, we assemble, we create with pride,
In our creations, our hearts reside.
The little flaws, that’s what makes them shine,
It’s what sets us apart, our unique sign.
